name: Build Artifacts Cleaner
description: Scans registered repos for build-artifact directories across 15 toolchains (Rust/Maven target, node_modules, JS framework caches, Python caches, .NET obj/bin, Gradle/CMake/Flutter build, SwiftPM/CocoaPods, Terraform, Elixir, Zig, Haskell, Composer vendor), shows per-repo sizes and last-build age, offers guarded one-click cleanup, and warns via the bell + status ticker when reclaimable disk crosses a threshold.
author: sstraus
